$schema-comment: Claude Code plugin hook manifest. The Stop event fires once per assistant response — every turn end. The hook calls `bettermemory audit-turn`, which reads the hook's stdin JSON (session_id + transcript_path), runs `probe_for_miss` against the active store, and writes `turn_audited` / `search_miss` events to the on-disk event log. The CLI is designed to always exit 0; the trailing `|| true` is belt-and-suspenders so a uvx network failure, an older PyPI version that doesn't yet have the subcommand, or any other unexpected shape never surfaces as a hook error banner in Claude Code. Losing one turn of telemetry is preferable to interrupting the user.
